releases.name: v0.3.0 - three cooperating skills, a clean reading copy, three hard gates
releases.notes:
v0.3.0 — three cooperating skills, a clean reading copy, three hard gates

This release turns the single research skill into a small family: the core deep
research skill plus two optional capability skills it hands work off to, with a
cleaner deliverable and a stricter delivery gate. It is the full diff from
v0.2.0.

## Three cooperating skills

- **`meld-deepresearch`** — the core research / evidence / citation loop. Still
 Python-standard-library only.
- **`meld-da`** — an Excel / spreadsheet data-analysis workflow (reading,
 cleaning, filtering, aggregation, statistics, charts, export), adapted from
 SenseNova-Skills' `sn-da-excel-workflow` (MIT) and reworked for portable use.
 Its Python packages are optional; without them it degrades to the built-in
 zero-dependency reader.
- **`meld-search-academic`** — academic search, paper full-text and section
 reading, and citation-tree tracing across arXiv, Semantic Scholar, Google
 Scholar, PubMed, Crossref, OpenAlex, SSRN, Wikipedia and more, adapted from
 `sn-search-academic` (MIT). Its browser-crawler tier is optional and degrades
 to the official APIs and then to generic search.

Cross-skill hand-offs are documented in `references/protocol.md` section 2a:
local table files plus analysis route to `meld-da`; academic, scientific or
historical subjects route the scholarly layer through `meld-search-academic`.

en.headline: 3 own commits, 6 automated, 1 issue opened, v0.3.0 released
en.summary: On 2026-10-06, `sogeisetsu` logged **3 own commits** in `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` plus 6 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. The own commits cut the `v0.3.1` release, added high-intent search terms to skill descriptions, and made the academic degrade test dependency-aware while drawing gate 3. No pull requests or reviews were filed. One issue was opened: `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills-DeepResearch` #11, asking to make the harness extensible (supporting OpenCode/Pi) and consider exposing it via MCP. In `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` #458, `goworm` replied about the OpenCode v2 skills install path fix and then closed the issue. `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` shipped tag `v0.3.0`, restructuring the single research skill into a family of three cooperating skills with a cleaner deliverable and three hard gates. `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` gained 1 star.

releaseNotes.summary: Turns the single research skill into a family: the core `meld-deepresearch` skill plus optional `meld-da` (Excel/spreadsheet data analysis, adapted from `sn-da-excel-workflow`) and a third skill, with a cleaner deliverable and three hard delivery gates. Full diff from v0.2.0.

zh.headline: 3 次本人提交、6 次自动提交、新开 1 个 issue、发布 v0.3.0
zh.summary: 2026-10-06，`sogeisetsu` 在 `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 完成 **3 次本人提交**，另有 6 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。本人提交包括切出 `v0.3.1` 版本、为 skill 描述补充高意图搜索词，以及让学术降级测试依赖感知并绘制 gate 3。当日无 PR 与 review。新开 1 个 issue：`OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills-DeepResearch` #11，建议让 harness 可扩展（支持 OpenCode/Pi 等）并考虑以 MCP 形式对外暴露。在 `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` #458 中，`goworm` 回复了 OpenCode v2 skills 安装路径修复情况，随后关闭了该 issue。`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 发布标签 `v0.3.0`，将单一研究 skill 拆分为三个协作 skill，交付物更简洁并引入三道硬性交付门。`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 新增 1 颗星。

releaseNotes.summary: 将单一研究 skill 扩展为 skill 家族：核心 `meld-deepresearch` 加上可选的 `meld-da`（Excel/表格数据分析，改编自 `sn-da-excel-workflow`）以及第三个 skill，交付物更简洁并引入三道硬性交付门。为相对 v0.2.0 的完整差异。
